messages.content: You are DeployOps, an autonomous incident-response agent for the Nortavia platform team. You investigate production incidents step by step by calling tools. Tools available to you: [{"name":"get_deployment","description":"Fetch metadata, rollout status and the change list for a deployment","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"deployment_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["deployment_id"]}},{"name":"search_logs","description":"Search recent log lines of a service for a substring","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"service":{"type":"string"},"query":{"type":"string"},"minutes":{"type":"integer","description":"look-back window in minutes"}},"required":["service","query","minutes"]}},{"name":"get_metrics","description":"Fetch a metric time series for a service","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"service":{"type":"string"},"metric":{"type":"string","enum":["error_rate","latency_p99","pod_restarts","db_pool_in_use"]},"minutes":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["service","metric","minutes"]}}]. Respond ONLY with a single JSON object and nothing else - no prose, no markdown, no code fences. To call a tool respond {"tool": "<name>", "arguments": {...}}. To finish respond {"final": "<your conclusion and recommended remediation>"}. Call exactly one tool per turn, prefer gathering evidence over guessing, and never produce a final answer while any reported lead remains unverified.

Deployment 8412 of checkout-api finished about 20 minutes ago, and now the error-rate alarm for checkout-api is firing at 12% against a 2% threshold. Customers are reporting failed checkouts. Investigate and find the root cause.

{"tool_result":{"deployment_id":"8412","service":"checkout-api","version":"2026.08.14-r3","status":"succeeded","pods_updated":"12/12","finished_at":"2026-08-14T09:41:12Z","changes":["bump payments-client 4.2.0 -> 5.0.1","route payment calls through shared pgbouncer","remove legacy retry wrapper"]}}

{"tool_result":{"matches":214,"sample":["09:44:02 ERROR PaymentsClient: connection pool exhausted (max=20) acquiring connection to payments-db","09:44:07 ERROR checkout failed: upstream timeout after 5000 ms calling payments-svc","09:45:31 ERROR PaymentsClient: connection pool exhausted (max=20)","09:47:12 ERROR readiness probe failed: /ready returned 503"]}}

New information from the on-call channel: payments-svc has also been degraded since 09:40, a config change CFG-2291 lowering pgbouncer max_client_conn from 400 to 100 was merged at 09:35, and checkout-api pods have restarted several times in the last ten minutes. Verify each of these leads with tools before any final answer: check checkout-api pod_restarts and db_pool_in_use metrics, check payments-svc error_rate, search payments-svc logs for pgbouncer or connection errors, and establish whether CFG-2291 or deployment 8412 is the actual trigger. Continue the investigation one tool call at a time.
